remarks: Looking for a charming and renovated place to live in the Cove neighborhood of Stamford? Look no further. This just renovated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home features quartz kitchen countertops, stainless steel appliances, new floors, and in-unit laundry. The main level of this features a spacious living room, eat-in-kitchen, half bathroom, and laundry area. On the upper level, you'll find two bedrooms and a full bathroom. Two off-street parking spaces are included within a shared driveway. Landlord covers all exterior maintenance & trash. Good credit (650 or better with no red flags), income verification, background check, and rental application are required. Private garage space available for $100 /mo. Schedule a tour before it's gone. 2 months security. Tenant pays electric utilities. Trash and water included.
